Company

Founded in Dubai in 2012, W Motors is the first manufacturer of high-performance luxury sports cars in the Middle East, now a fully integrated mobility solutions provider.

From the Lykan HyperSport and the Fenyr SuperSport to the GHIATH program with Dubai Police, every W is designed, engineered and built in the UAE.

Services

Everything under one roof

From design and engineering to consultancy and turnkey manufacturing, for OEMs, governments and partners.

Styling & Design (exterior & interior)

01

Our Dubai design centre shapes every surface in-house, from the first sketch to a validated body, for our own hypercars and for partners.

Engineering & Prototyping

02

Full vehicle engineering, R&D and prototyping, from concept validation to pre-production builds.

Carbon fibre & composites

03

The region's only automotive-focused composites division, producing structural and visible carbon fibre inside our Dubai facility.

Electrical & Electronics

04

Vehicle electrical architecture, electronics and smart systems, including electric and autonomous platforms.

Manufacturing

05

Assembly and production lines with a capacity exceeding 7,000 units per year, built to accommodate every production model.

Armoring, Trim & Upholstery

06

Armoring and bespoke interiors for specialist vehicles, from the GHIATH program to Special Projects for specific sectors and markets.

HQ and Factory

Designed, engineered and built in Dubai
